read_pfm_file: read a PFM file and return the image data array and scale factor
write_pfm_file: write a float32 numpy array to a PFM file with a given scale
read_image_rgb: read an image file and return an RGB numpy array normalized to 0-1
resize_image_for_network: resize an image to network-compatible dimensions aligned to 32 pixel multiples
write_depth_map: write a depth map to both PFM and PNG files with configurable bit depth
